args.body:
One more angle on NextStage: pipeline tracking for federal contractors usually means someone keeping records current as opportunities move, which is steady, repetitive work that grows with each new customer.

A Koya Talent automation assistant could own that upkeep so your team spends its time on the product. Would a short conversation be useful?
